subject.title: sandbox: run abort/timeout cannot cancel in-flight Docker sandbox startup; hung docker CLI process leaks past run termination

question: Should cancellation become a documented optional contract for every sandbox backend factory, with built-in Docker and SSH implementations required to honor it during startup?
rationale: The mechanical Docker fix is clear, but `CreateSandboxBackendParams` is a shared backend boundary whose cancellation semantics affect built-in and potentially registered backends.

options.title: Adopt a shared cancellation contract
options.body: Add an optional abort signal to the shared factory/context boundary, require built-in Docker and SSH startup paths to honor it, and document the abort error behavior.

options.title: Limit the repair to Docker
options.body: Pass cancellation only through the Docker startup path, accepting that SSH and future backend factories retain separate lifecycle semantics.

recommendation.title: Adopt a shared cancellation contract
recommendation.body: Add an optional abort signal to the shared factory/context boundary, require built-in Docker and SSH startup paths to honor it, and document the abort error behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The reporter supplied the clearest current call-chain and live-reproduction evidence for the proposed contract boundary.
